source:
@@U02765@@
About your heads
hover the forms of all living things,
in motion, and yet dead.
What once was,
in all radiance and splendor,
moves there still,
seeking a place in Eternity.
And you, in your omnipotence,
divide it between the bright canopy of day
and the vault of night; some to be caught up
in life’s bless¢d course, others to be sought out
by the fearless magician, who alone,
intrepidly, reveals for all to see,
what is worthy of wonder.

@@U02767@@
His glowing key no sooner touches the censer
than at once a misty vapor engulfs the stage.
Stealing in, it billows in cloudlike fashion,
stretching, swelling, condensing,
twining about, parting, joining.
But now behold a spirit masterpiece.
As they approach they make music!
Airy tones create a mystery,
and as they move all things become melody.
Everything, columns, triglyph, rings;
I truly believe the entire temple is singing!
The mist is settling now, and through the haze,
with measured step,
a beautiful youth steps forth.
Here I end my task, for I needn't name him.
Who could fail to know the charming Paris.

@@U02768@@
(PARIS steps forward.)

@@U02770@@
O what a sight of youth and vigor!
translation:
@@U02765@@
关于你的头
盘旋在所有生物的形态上，
运动着，却又死了。
曾经是什么，
在所有的光辉和辉煌中，
仍然移动在那里，
寻求在永恒中的一席之地。
而你，以你的全能，
将它划分在白天明亮的天篷之间
和黑夜的穹顶；有些会被追上
在人生的幸福历程中，需要寻找其他人
由无所畏惧的魔术师独自一人，
勇敢地向所有人展示，
有什么值得好奇的。

@@U02767@@
他发光的钥匙刚接触到香炉
舞台立刻被一层薄雾笼罩。
潜入，它以云般的方式翻腾，
拉伸、膨胀、收缩、
缠绕、分离、结合。
但现在看到的是精神杰作。
当他们靠近时，他们会演奏音乐！
空灵的色调营造出神秘感，
当他们移动时，一切都变成了旋律。
一切，柱子，三字形，环；
我真的相信整个寺庙都在唱歌！
雾气渐渐散去，透过薄雾，
测量步长，
一个美丽的青年走了出来。
我的任务到此结束，因为我不必说出他的名字。
谁能不知道迷人的巴黎。

@@U02768@@
（巴黎向前迈出了一步。）

@@U02770@@
啊，这是多么青春和活力的景象啊！
